classes.A: read-only / idempotent — replays from the recording forever, no contract needed
classes.B: create / accumulate — needs a mutation gate + {{unique}} value substitution + best-effort archive teardown
classes.C: consume-a-precondition — needs a hand-written arrange/act/assert/teardown contract
classes.D: configure / toggle — needs generic ensure-to-state semantics (flip to X, skip if already there) — GENERIC MECHANISM BUILT 2026-09-10 in renderer/replay.mjs + renderer/ensure-to-state.mjs (unit-tested, 19/19 passing): covers (a) label-flip buttons (Activate<->Deactivate etc — skip if the opposite-state control now resolves instead), (b) status radio/checkbox/switch groups (skip if already selected), (c) field-value edits (skip retyping if the field already holds the recorded value). State-setting steps bypass the mutation gate entirely (KBS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS not required) since the live-state check makes them safe by construction. NOT yet covered: list-membership/append shapes (#57 tag-with-'Already added'-guard, #62 appends a question) — a 4th strategy (skip-if-already-in-the-list) is still needed. No live-browser end-to-end verification yet — replay.mjs needs a working browser profile (blocked on item 4, the auth/staging decision).
classes.E: data-gated wizard — arrange must first rebuild the gate (e.g. an entity without a manual); often external/regulatory, sometimes pinned instead of automated
classes.F: other — doesn't fit the step shape at all (e.g. a drag-and-drop graph edit)

items.note: inverse: #22. TRIAL RUN (unresolved, not blocked): agent queued a real employee (CRD-holding, active) with a valid FINRA role and start date (selected via the actual calendar widget, twice), then clicking "Add 1 employee" produced no toast, no error, and no visible state change — reproduced twice. The agent's own diagnosis blamed an unguarded startDate.toISOString() on a non-Date value, but that is NOT corroborated: packages/ui/src/v3/date_picker.tsx's onSelect receives a real Date from react-day-picker, and useAddBranchPersonnel's .catch() should surface any backend error as a toast regardless. Root cause unconfirmed — could be a genuine backend/silent-exception bug, or a lingering popover overlay intercepting the automated click. Needs a human with devtools/network tab open to pin down; not marked ai_record:blocked since a real user's click may behave differently than Playwright's coordinate click.

The seeded employees live in branches_branchindividual/group 17662 (what the Branches UI writes), so they are invisible to the FINRA-scoped picker. Either a U4 data sync for 1013 or a backend fix to fall back to branch personnel when no U4 data exists would unblock #18 and then #17.

BLOCKED by feature flag: Check Blotter is HIDDEN for company 1013 (company_company.check_blotter='HIDDEN'; page renders a marketing placeholder unless ACTIVE), and check_blotter_record has 0 rows for 1013. Even once enabled there is NO unresolve: resolution_status only accepts COMPLIANT/NON_COMPLIANT (dto_check_blotter.py) and resolved records never re-flag — so the recipe shape would be fresh-instance-per-run via the "Log check" dialog (permission check_blotter.checks.log_on_behalf; create_check_record auto-FLAGS when forwarding_date is late vs receipt_date), then resolve. Needs the flag flipped by Hadrius ops first.

2/2 clean on the standing Pending-review pool (Action required filter), self-resetting: act = review modal footer "..." -> "Reject disclosure" (optional reason) -> confirm; assert = Resolved row shows Rejected; teardown = row "More actions" -> "Reopen disclosure" -> Reopen (backend reopen_disclosure: APPROVED/REJECTED -> PENDING_REVIEW, employee not notified). Reject (not approve) is the reversible decision here: an approved disclosure becomes an ACTIVE firm record whose menu offers only Request amendment / Close disclosure, and Close is terminal (no reopen) — confirmed by hand on Aisha Khan's G&E, now permanently Closed. Gotchas: after a decision the modal closes and re-opens on the next pending item ~1s later, and the decision toast (fixed top-right) covers the modal's header X, so closing needs a synthetic click / Escape, not a real mouse click. A fresh pending item can be manufactured via #65's logOnBehalfAndSubmit if the pool ever empties.

2/2 clean on the standing pool of submitted-but-unreviewed certification tasks (People oversight > Certifications > Submissions, default view = Needs review: Lucas Romano, Hermione Granger, Brian O'Sullivan, Daniel Kim in the ACTIVE round "Quarterly Compliance Certification"). act = row kebab (aria-haspopup=menu, no label) -> "Quick approve" -> "Approve anyway" (unreviewed-flags confirm) -> toast "Submission approved"; assert = fresh navigation to ?statuses=approved lists the row; teardown = row menu -> "Re-open submission" -> "Re-open" -> toast "Submission reopened" (POST tasks/<id>/reopen, APPROVED/REJECTED -> UNREVIEWED). No second persona needed after all (was tagged secondPersona): pool is pre-submitted, and admin "Submit on behalf of..." exists on /employee/certifications if it ever runs dry.
